killer.title: Unsent remittance note
killer.content: An unsigned note lists an amount and a date, with the words 'final payment' underlined twice. No recipient is named.

killer.title: Carbon copy of a transfer
killer.content: A carbon copy records a cash transfer through a local office. The account reference has been partially erased.

killer.title: Payment calendar
killer.content: Several dates are circled beside the same amount. The last date is crossed out and replaced.

killer.title: Unmarked deposit envelope
killer.content: An empty bank envelope bears a teller's stamp and a penciled figure on its flap.

killer.title: Draft debt acknowledgment
killer.content: A draft acknowledgment accepts a debt but disputes the interest. The signature line is blank.

killer.title: Exchange counter receipt
killer.content: A receipt records a currency exchange shortly before a handwritten payment date.

killer.title: Torn account notation
killer.content: A ledger fragment lists two initials and a recurring sum. The page number is missing.

killer.title: Unposted money order
killer.content: A money order is filled in but has no recipient or postal cancellation mark.

victim.title: Unmarked payment slip
victim.content: A payment slip is kept with household bills. The recipient line is blank, but its amount matches a penciled figure on the reverse.

victim.title: Anonymous demand
victim.content: A short typed demand requires payment by Friday and warns against contacting the police. No signature appears.

victim.title: Bank withdrawal stub
victim.content: A withdrawal stub shows a sum larger than the usual household expenses. The teller's mark is clear.

victim.title: Envelope with a cut window
victim.content: A reused envelope has its address window cut out and a date written inside the flap.

victim.title: Household ledger discrepancy
victim.content: A household ledger records a cash withdrawal that does not appear in the matching bank statement.

victim.title: Unsent request for time
victim.content: A draft letter asks for another week to produce a sum of money. The recipient is addressed only as 'Sir'.

victim.title: Pawnbroker's valuation
victim.content: A valuation slip lists a watch and a ring, both marked as not sold.

victim.title: Telephone bill notation
victim.content: A telephone bill has one evening call circled, with no name written beside it.
